newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Tabacalera ups cigarette price.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Tabacalera ups cigarette price.

text.p: Spain's Tabacalera said on Monday it had approved a second increase in three months in the price of its blond cigarettes to compensate for a tax hike last summer.
This 20 peseta per pack increase is effective soon, the firm said, without specifying when.
"This is due to the tax increase," a spokesman told Reuters.
Tabacalera had already raised prices on its blond tobacco brands in December in reaction to the government's tax hike last July, the company said.
The firm is expected to announce 1996 results later today.
